rule_1_derivation_plan.note: Every number below is derived or cited; the tool authors none.
rule_1_derivation_plan.volume_law: V_i = m_i / rho_muscle with m_i the admitted musc_mass and rho_muscle = 1060 kg/m^3 = 1.06e-6 kg/mm^3 -- THE DATASET'S OWN closure constant (adapters_muscle.MUSCLE_DENSITY_KG_M3, the law that admits each row: PCSA = m/(rho*FL)); independently the classic measured mammalian skeletal-muscle density (Mendez & Keys 1960, J Appl Physiol 15:617-621, ~1.06 g/cm^3), so the constant is both the admitted law and a cited physical measurement.
rule_1_derivation_plan.path_law: p_origin, p_insertion = the muscle-path lane's neutral-pose origin_point_m / insertion_point_m (converted m -> mm by x1000); L = straight_length_m (admitted). No path is re-estimated.
rule_1_derivation_plan.capsule_law: radius r solves pi r^2 L - (2/3) pi r^3 = V (a capsule of axis length L: cylinder pi r^2 (L - 2r) plus two hemispherical caps (4/3) pi r^3). Closed-form monotone solve (bisection to 1e-12 relative on [0, L/2]); the solution exists iff V <= pi L^3/6 (the sphere bound at r = L/2). If a muscle exceeded the bound the fallback is the prolate spheroid with semi-major L/2 and semi-minor b = sqrt(3V/(2 pi L)) -- both laws closed-form, whichever branch used is recorded per muscle. Predicted: no muscle approaches the bound (belly volumes are far below the sphere bound).
rule_1_derivation_plan.mass_law: the kernel's own: mass = area(triangles) x thickness x density, with thickness := V / A_mesh -- the same derived-equivalent-shell pattern the skeleton lane used, which makes stated mass == V * rho_muscle exactly and keeps the kernel's 5% check a live falsifier rather than a formality.
rule_1_derivation_plan.mesh_law: surface of revolution: 48 circumferential segments x 52 meridian parallels over the analytic polar profile (a DISCRETIZATION choice, not a shape parameter: the analytic solid is fixed by V and L; only the triangle count varies, the mass law closes through t := V/A, and the 0.5% enclosed-volume gate is measured on every muscle). Vertex frame: millimetres, the skeleton body's convention.
rule_1_derivation_plan.attachment_law: attachment is carried as the measured landmark book per muscle (origin/insertion segment + landmark u,v + joint-frame points + the path lane's moment arms at neutral) -- the bones this layer would bond to do not exist as matter on the adult scaffold (no adult bone geometry is admitted: the memo's central measured gap), so there are NO bonds in this body. Bonds to adult bone compartments are named successor work the day an adult bone layer lands as matter. No bond is invented here.
rule_1_derivation_plan.force_note: max_force_N and the moment arms ride in the audit table as ADMITTED numbers of the path lane; this layer makes no new force claim. The path lane's falsified directions (knee extension, MTP flexion) stay falsified here.
